# Traegerportal

[![Made with love by it@M][made-with-love-shield]][itm-opensource]

This project provides a central digital portal for independent, non-profit and other childcare providers in Munich, including parent initiatives (EKIs), as well as prospective providers.

The portal enables providers to:

  - access relevant information and guidance;
  - submit applications and enquiries online;
  - access links to relevant specialist IT systems; and
  - communicate securely with the City of Munich administration.

The portal is intended to replace email-based communication between providers/EKIs and the municipal administration. Responsible KITA-FT caseworkers can manage, process and respond to submitted applications and enquiries directly within the portal.

Target groups

  - External: Independent, non-profit and other childcare providers in Munich, including EKIs, as well as prospective providers
  - Internal: City of Munich KITA-FT caseworkers
